capture_rule: Capture the complete primary open article, article PDF, supplementary information, reporting summary and complete source-data workbook for Yin et al., Elucidating protonation pathways in CO2 photoreduction using the kinetic isotope effect, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-44753-x. Preserve every H2O/D2O isotopologue identity, catalyst and material identity, reaction-path identity, exposure and illumination condition, measured production or decay-rate identity, rate-ratio identity, uncertainty, replicate, figure, table, workbook cell, adverse or unresolved record and every separately declared fitted or calculated record in source order. Do not select by isotope-effect direction, magnitude, mechanism, agreement, condition, method, figure or completeness. Do not fit, average, digitize an unreported value, infer a missing value or use a calculated record as an experimental measurement.
source_selection_boundary: The DOI-identified complete article and its complete linked supplement, reporting summary and source workbook are fixed before any target-bearing file opens, before executable-law registration, before candidate enumeration and before prediction-program construction. The source is selected structurally because it is a primary open experimental comparison of retained H2O and D2O reaction identities on the same declared TiO2 systems, with explicit rate and inverse kinetic-isotope signatures, multiple conditions, complete linked source data and retained experimental-versus-interpretive provenance. Observation informed the question and is disclosed; no observed isotope-effect value or desired direction selects a Fold form.
